title: KJI首席：香港楼市复苏更坚实，人口增长驱动真实需求
speaker: Cousin Lender

segments.en: And talking about Hong Kong property, I mean part of that whole IPO is really kind of driving a lot of the real estate market to come back. How real is it this recovery you think this time around?
segments.zh: 谈到香港房地产，IPO热潮也在推动楼市回暖。您认为这次复苏有多真实？

segments.en: I think this is much more than last 15 years when I look at the Hong Kong oil market. I think this time around there's not different by liquidity. There was not different by speculation.
segments.zh: 我认为这比过去15年看到的任何一次都更坚实。这次不是由流动性驱动，也不是由投机驱动。

segments.en: There was purely driven by population in Hong Kong increasing, and there is demand for housing.
segments.zh: 纯粹是由香港人口增长和住房需求驱动的。

segments.en: And that drive the rent to yield increased to surpass the mortgage rate. I think that looks to be much more solid than all the past upcycle I have seen.
segments.zh: 这推动租金收益率超过抵押贷款利率。我认为这看起来比我见过的所有过去上升周期都更坚实。
